textbookText: Note: Pure zinc cannot be used in the preparation of hydrogen gas because the reaction is fast and produced hydrogen gas surrounds the zinc piece and keeps the acid ou.t of contact with zinc. Nitric acid cannot be used for the preparation of hydrogen gas as it oxidises Zn and it itself gets reduced to nitric oxide gas.
Object: TO PREPARE SULPHUR DIOXIDE GAS AND STUDYATS

Sulphur dioxide gas can be prepared by heating the copper turnings with conc. sulphuric acid. This gas is collected by upward displacement of air since it is water soluble and heavier than air. + 2H2S04 cuS04 + 2H20 + S02 t conc.
